testsuite.name: taxonomy.ProposalMemoReplayTest

testcase.name: on mode - identical proposal twice runs the action once and replays id and label consumption exactly()
shadow mode skips nothing and reports zero mismatches()
on mode - a lossy-memo hit is never stored in the exact memo()
on mode - the uncached-base double execution is replayed and the base is primed()
shadow mode counts a stored rejection that the full evaluation now accepts as a mismatch()
an action with unrestored side effects is never stored()
memo self-disables on a counter invariant violation and falls back to full evaluation()
off mode never consults or fills the exact memo()
